title: Scientist MS&T – Pharma Sterile Manufacturing Drug Product
description: 12-month contract | 100% | Hybrid | Start January 2027 Are you a pharmaceutical manufacturing professional with first industry experience in sterile drug products, looking to take the next step in your career? For our client, an international biopharmaceutical company, we are looking for a motivated Scientist to join the Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T) team, supporting commercial parenteral manufacturing at external manufacturing partners (CMOs). Your responsibilities Provide technical support for commercial sterile drug product manufacturing Support technology transfers, process validation and scale-up activities Investigate manufacturing deviations, perform root cause analysis and support CAPA and change management Monitor process performance and drive process robustness and continuous improvement Review technical documentation, validation protocols and process risk assessments Collaborate with international manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams Your profile Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Engineering or a related discipline, preferably MSc or PhD 2–4 years of industry experience in commercial sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing Knowledge of sterile filtration, steam sterilization, aseptic filling, vials, syringes and/or lyophilization Sound understanding of cGMP, FDA requirements and EU GMP Annex 1 Experience in deviation management, CAPA and change control Strong technical writing, analytical and communication skills Fluent English; basic German or Italian is an advantage Willingness to travel internationally (10–20%) This assignment offers an exciting opportunity to expand your technical expertise in sterile manufacturing and develop your career in MS&T within a global pharmaceutical network. The position is based in Switzerland, with 50% on-site presence and a 40-hour working week. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
